title: Workshop: build a landing section
summary: Size a hero and a row of cards step by step, choosing rem, em, ch, vh and px for the right jobs.
intro: a landing section with a full-height hero, a button and a row of feature cards. The HTML is already written (see the html tab). Each step uses a different unit for a reason: `rem` for text and spacing, `em` inside the button, `ch` for line length, `vh` for the hero and `px` for fine details.
